name: Ammo at the most
author: Keros, glawks
description: Individual ammo purchases start at the maximum affordable amount; Square (Xbox X) on the vendor list also buys ammo for all owned weapons in one action, with normal prices and HUD feedback.

settings.name: Detailed log
settings.description: For bug reports: a line in the game's log each time the count is set (the weapon, its ammo, the bolts and the price).

settings.name: Show vendor ammo HUD
settings.description: Show the Square / Xbox X buy-all prompt, price and purchase feedback in the weapon vendor.

settings.name: RAC1 controller button label
settings.description: RAC1 shows F for keyboard input automatically. Choose Xbox X or PlayStation Square for controller input; SDK 1.20 does not identify the controller model.

settings.name: RAC2 vendor HUD position
settings.description: RAC2 prompt placement. RAC1 uses a compact input-aware text prompt with a dark outline between the vendor controls.
